About Me

I'm a fresher UI/UX Designer passionate about creating simple, intuitive, and visually engaging digital experiences. I enjoy transforming ideas into meaningful user experiences through thoughtful layouts, clear visual hierarchy, and interactive prototypes.

I work primarily with Figma and have hands-on experience creating wireframes, user interfaces, prototypes, typography systems, and visual designs. I also use Canva to create supporting digital graphics and visual assets.

I'm continuously improving my design skills and looking forward to contributing to real-world products while growing as a UI/UX Designer.
